## Body

Plan 210 phase 2 (#160, FINAL at f886b8f, awaiting verdicts). For the next holder:
- AC7 is NOT done until after #160 merges: run docs/plans/210-workstreams/assets/evidence/ac7-repoint.sh (no args; --dry-run to preview). It runs one `pij directory edit <role> --why 'C29 rename (plan 210)' --file` per governance role citing docs/project/roadmaps/ (8 roles). Never before the merge: prompts must not point at a folder main lacks. Then open a small states PR (like #151/#154) listing the 8 writer commits and checking ac-0007/bp-0007.
- Coverage sensor: harness/scripts/coverage-check.ts (just coverage-check; harness checks stage `coverage`; self-check). Known gaps are in harness/scripts/coverage-exemptions.json with owner docs-system; it fails on new gaps AND stale exemptions, so guan's AC4 PR must delete rows it covers.
- ddocs gotchas: switch a doc's schema id in the same commit as moving it (E406). `ddocs set` on plan task files re-indents and drops the top-level "references" key: re-dump with tabs and restore it. `ddocs set` on skill examples leaves non-biome formatting: run biome format before pushing (CI lint caught it).
- Readers of the workstream folder (picture.rs, claims.rs, http/claims.rs) take workstreams first, roadmaps as fallback; keep the roadmaps alias tests.
- F104: CI validates no ddocs until @ai-substrate/dd is on npm (ruling C20); don't install it in CI.
- pr-freeze lives in harness/scripts/pr-freeze.ts on #157's branch until it merges; run it via tsx from a temp copy.
